(import scheme (chicken base) (chicken io))

(define (factor)
  (let ((token (list-ref tokens position)))
    (set! position (+ position 1))
    (if (string=? token "(")
        (begin
          (set! position (+ position 1))
          (let ((value (expression)))
            (set! position (+ position 1))
            value))
        (string->number token))))

(define (term)
  (let loop ((value (factor)))
    (if (or (string=? (list-ref tokens position) "*")
            (string=? (list-ref tokens position) "/"))
        (loop (* value (factor))))
    value))

(define (expression)
  (let loop ((value (term)))
    (if (or (string=? (list-ref tokens position) "+")
            (string=? (list-ref tokens position) "-"))
        (loop (if (string=? (list-ref tokens position) "+")
                  (+ value (term))
                  (- value (term)))))
    value))

(let* ((line (read-line))
       (tokens (regexp-split #px"[\\d+\\-*/()]+" line))
       (position 0))
  (display (expression))
  (newline))
